# ezghcloud_database (Resource)

A managed PostgreSQL, Percona Server or MariaDB database, reached at one endpoint. Destroying it takes a final backup unless final_backup_on_destroy is false.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_type` (String) A gp-1 or gs-1 instance type. Changes in place.
- `name` (String) Database name.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the database.
- `storage_size_gib` (Number) Storage size in GiB. Grows in place; shrinking is refused.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet (sbn_) the endpoint lives in. Changing it replaces the database.

### Optional

- `allowed_source_cidrs` (List of String) 1 to 20 IPv4 CIDRs allowed to connect. Left out, the VPC's ranges.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Days automated backups are kept, 1 to 35.
- `backup_window_utc` (String) Daily backup window, HH:MM-HH:MM UTC, at least 30 minutes.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) While true, the database can't be destroyed.
- `description` (String) Optional description; null clears it.
- `engine` (String) postgresql, percona or mariadb. Required unless restoring, where the source fixes it. Changing it replaces the database.
- `engine_version` (String) Engine major version. Required unless restoring, where the source fixes it. It can't change here, because a replacement would destroy data: major upgrades go through a blue/green deployment, after which set it to the new version.
- `final_backup_on_destroy` (Boolean) Take a final backup, which outlives the database, when destroying it.
- `log_exports` (Set of String) Engine logs sent to Observability: error, slow and audit.
- `maintenance_window_utc` (String) Weekly maintenance window, ddd:HH:MM-ddd:HH:MM UTC, at least 30 minutes.
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for each asynchronous operation, for example 60m.
- `parameters` (Map of String) Engine parameters. The whole set: a key left out goes back to its default. Only configured keys are read back.
- `source_backup_id` (String) Restore this backup (dbb_) into the new database. Set it alone. Only applies at create: a later change or removal is ignored.
- `source_database_id` (String) Restore this database (dbi_) at source_time into the new database. Only applies at create: a later change or removal is ignored.
- `source_time` (String) Point in time to restore source_database_id at, an RFC 3339 instant. Only applies at create: a later change or removal is ignored.
- `storage_iops` (Number) Provisioned storage IOPS. Changes in place.
- `storage_throughput_mbps` (Number) Provisioned storage throughput in MB/s. Changes in place.
- `storage_volume_type` (String) Storage volume type, gp1. Changing it replaces the database.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `admin_secret_id` (String) The Secret (sec_) holding the admin username and password. Terraform state never holds the password.
- `endpoint_hostname` (String) The endpoint's DNS name; null until it resolves.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) The endpoint's port.
- `id` (String) Database ID (dbi_).
- `operation_id` (String) Most recent operation initiated by this resource; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) What the database is doing.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the subnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_database.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
